Photobiomodulation

Six wavelengths
Each with a purpose

Every colour of light interacts with your skin at a cellular level. Each wavelength penetrates to a different depth, triggering a different biological response. Nur Skincoach selects the right combination for your skin, your goals, and your moment.

660
Anti-Aging

Red Light

630 – 660 nm
  • Stimulates fibroblasts to produce collagen and elastin
  • Visibly reduces fine lines and wrinkles
  • Accelerates cellular renewal and skin repair
830
Deep Repair

Near Infrared

830 nm Invisible to the naked eye
  • Penetrates the deepest tissue layer, beneath the dermis
  • Reduces inflammation and supports cellular recovery
  • Improves local microcirculation and oxygen delivery
415
Clarity

Blue Light

415 nm
  • Destroys acne-causing bacteria (Cutibacterium acnes)
  • Reduces sebum production and minimises pores
  • Prevents future breakouts without drying the skin
580
Radiance

Yellow Light

570 – 590 nm
  • Stimulates lymphatic drainage and detoxification
  • Evens skin tone and reduces vascular redness
  • Restores a naturally luminous, rested complexion
525
Pigmentation

Green Light

520 – 530 nm
  • Targets overactive melanocytes at the source
  • Fades dark spots, sun damage and melasma
  • Harmonises overall skin tone over time
410
Dual Action

Violet Light

400 – 420 nm
  • Combines anti-aging and antibacterial effects simultaneously
  • Calms reactive and sensitised skin
  • Reduces surface inflammation and post-blemish redness

Wavelength efficacy based on peer-reviewed photobiomodulation research, including Wunsch & Matuschka (2014). Individual results may vary.
